t=$(mktemp -d); t=$(cd "$t" && pwd -P)
mkdir -p "$t/src"; echo hi > "$t/src/f.txt"
for s in 20260101-010000 20260102-020000 20260103-030000 20260104-040000; do
  BACKUP_STAMP=$s bash backup.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name demo "$t/src" >/dev/null
done

echo "--- rotate --keep=2 --dry-run (equals form) ---"
bash rotate.sh --dest="$t/dest" --name=demo --keep=2 --dry-run 2>/dev/null
echo "--- rotate --keep 2 (sidecars follow archives) ---"
bash rotate.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --keep 2 2>/dev/null
ls "$t/dest" | sort
echo "--- rotate --keep 0 rejected ---"
bash rotate.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --keep 0; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- rotate unknown option ---"
bash rotate.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --bogus 2>&1 | tail -1; echo "rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
echo "--- rotate --help exits 0 ---"
bash rotate.sh --help >/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- rotate positional arg rejected ---"
bash rotate.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name demo extra 2>/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- verify --name filter ---"
bash verify.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name demo; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- verify missing dest dir -> rc=2 ---"
bash verify.sh --quiet --dest "$t/nodir" 2>/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
rm -rf "$t"

result:
All 11 tests pass (`bash tests/run_tests.sh`). What I did:

- **rotate.sh**: the surplus list was taken with `tail -n +"$keep"`, which started *at* the KEEP-th line of the oldest-first list — so exactly N backups with `--keep N` deleted the newest. Surplus is now `head -n "$((total - keep))"` (the oldest entries) and the "nothing to rotate" early exit fires at `total <= keep`.
- **verify.sh**: the sidecar line was split with `awk '{print $2}'`, truncating names with spaces at the first space. It now uses `read -r expected file <<< "$line"`, so the whole rest of the line is the file name; also quoted the digest comparison.
- **lib/common.sh** (new): the shared option-parsing block (`--dest/--name/--keep/-q/-n/-h/--`/`parse_local_option` hook + `--keep` validation) and `resolve_dir`, with the same double-sourcing guard style as `lib/log.sh`; sourced by rotate.sh and verify.sh, all flags unchanged (verified `--dest=`/`--keep=` equals forms, `--dry-run`, `--help`, unknown-option/missing-value/positional rejections, exit codes 1/2). backup.sh, restore.sh, report.sh untouched.
- **tests/run_tests.sh**: new rotate group (nothing deleted at exactly `--keep`; only oldest deleted past `--keep`) and a verify check for an intact archive named `my backup-20260101-000000.tar.gz`.

Changed files: `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `tests/run_tests.sh`, and new `lib/common.sh`.
